RECITALS: Seller is the owner infee of a certain parcel of landknown by the street address of 169 East 92nd Street, New York, New York, which is designated as Lot 31 in Block 1521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part hereof, together with the improvements thereon (said land being herein referred to as "Seller's Land," and said improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being herein referred to as "Seller's Building," and Seller's Land and Seller's Building being herein referred to as "Seller's Property"). B. Developer is the owner in fee of certain land adjacent to Seller's Land, known by the street addresses of 178-180 East 93'd Street and 182 East 93rd Street, New York, New York, which are designated as Lots 41,42 and 141 in Block 1521 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York, more particularly described in Schedule B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the "Developer's Land"). C. Developerhasindicated thatitmayrenovateorconstructanew building or buildings and improvements upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new or renovated building or buildings and improvements, together with any further replacements thereof or additions thereto whether made by Developer or Developer's successors or assigns, being herein referred to collectively as "Developer's Proposed Building" and collectively with Developer's Land, "Developer's Property"). D.As used herein the "Excess Development Rights" shall mean all of the Floor Area Development Rights that are appurtenant to Seller's Land in excess of the Floor Area Development Rights which are utilized by the improvements located on Seller's Land on the date hereof. For the purposes of this Agreement, Seller and Developer agree, without representation or recourse, that based on the Survey (hereinafter defined), the Excess Development Rights are deemed to be at least 1,600 square feet.
